name: Editorial paper
summary: Warm paper, editorial serif, hairline rules, magazine hierarchy. Calm and credible.
avoid_for: very short punchy hooks that want shouting type

rules.grid: Single 904 px column on 88 px margins. Titles hang from the top rule; footer sits on a hairline. No centred layouts except the quote.
rules.type: Display serif (Fraunces) for titles, stat numerals and quotes; text serif (Source Serif 4) for body; a grotesque (Instrument Sans) only for labels, sources and chart text. Two weights per family.
rules.density: One idea per slide. A text slide is a title plus at most 50 words. Calm slides (one number, one quote) alternate with dense ones.
rules.accent: The brand accent appears once per slide at most: the accent words of a title (italic, accent colour), the highlighted bar, the list numerals. Never as a background block except on an accent surface slide.
rules.photo: Shown whole on a paper mat with a 2 px ink keyline and a caption line beneath. No crop, no filter.
rules.texture: None. Flat paper colour, ink rules.

layouts.cover-a: Masthead: logo top-left over a thick rule, photo (if any) as a matted plate, title set large at the bottom, standfirst in italic.
layouts.cover-b: Title first, filling the upper half; standfirst and photo share the bottom row.
layouts.text: Title hanging from the top rule, body below in a 904 px column.
layouts.list: Title, then numbered or ruled items separated by hairlines; accent on numerals only.
layouts.stat: One oversized serif numeral, its label in display serif, a short context line under a rule.
layouts.chart: Title, chart heading in small grotesque, the chart filling the rest.
layouts.quote: Large italic serif quote with a hanging opening mark, attribution under a short rule.
layouts.media: Title over a matted photo or a framed screenshot with numbered annotations.
layouts.logos: Title, then logos in ink on a quiet grid.
layouts.visual: Title over a bespoke SVG drawn in ink and one accent.
layouts.cta: Logo top-left, one action set large, the URL underlined in accent.
